title: Leadership
text:
Leadership




Oluwadamilola Desmond Awoyo
Founder, ODA - The Alternative for Change
Oluwadamilola Desmond Awoyo was born the second of four children in the Awoyo family, an upbringing that instilled in him early lessons in responsibility, community, and service to others. He pursued this foundation academically, earning his Bachelor’s degree in History and International Relations from Federal University of Lokoja, before furthering his studies abroad with a Master’s degree in Global Politics in the United Kingdom, and later a PhD from the University of Miami.
Over the past 15 years, Desmond has built a career in public service and philanthropy, working directly with communities to understand and address the everyday challenges they face. It was this hands-on experience - seeing firsthand the gap between promises made and change delivered - that led him to found ODA: The Alternative for Change. ODA was born from a simple conviction: that leadership should mean real Opportunities, visible Development, and unwavering Accountability to the people it serves.
Today, as he seeks to represent Owo/Ose in the House of Representatives this January, Desmond carries forward the same values that have guided him since childhood - a commitment to service, a belief in community, and a vision for a future where every constituent has access to opportunity and can trust their leadership to deliver.

title: News & Updates
text:
Latest Updates


ODA Bursary
[Jan 2026]
As part of ODA’s commitment to expanding opportunities across Owo/Ose, the organization is providing a 50,000 naira back-to-school grant to 1,000 students in the constituency. This initiative aims to ease the financial burden of returning to school and ensure more young people have the support they need to continue their education. It’s a direct reflection of ODA’s founding principle - that real change starts with real, tangible opportunities for the community.
